card.name: Small linking words mid-sentence
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, to, and, between, right) and an opening parenthesis, placed just before the next noun or detail. Seen in medical guidance, citations and news text.

modes.label: Preposition before a partner or group
modes.description: The word 'with', 'to' or 'between' links to the person or group that comes next.
modes.example: condomless sex or condom breaking during sex<< with>> a partner of unknown HIV-1 status

modes.label: Parenthesis after a file link
modes.description: An opening parenthesis follows 'Download PDF' and introduces a file size.
modes.example: American Art Comes of Age and Goes to Pieces Download PDF<< (>>9.7 MB) CONFLICT BETWEEN

modes.label: Joining word in a journal title
modes.description: 'and' sits inside a journal name in a reference list.

card.writes: No clear meaning; it weakly suppresses words like surroundings and environment.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words that come right before a person, group or detail is named.
